Struggling to survive in a decaying metropolis, a destitute former university student commits a brutal murder out of desperate nihilism. As he descends into a labyrinth of paranoia and feverish delirium, he becomes locked in a tense cat-and-mouse game with a brilliant, relentless detective. Consumed by suffocating guilt and the unraveling of his own moral philosophy, he must ultimately decide whether to confess or let his soul rot away entirely.
